briefdescription.para: Verifies that two Ethernet frames contain the same data.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies the frame data against a CheckFrame.

CheckFrame
Pointer to the expected Ethernet frame.
ActualFrame
Pointer to the received Ethernet frame.
XST_SUCCESS if the frames match, otherwise XST_FAILURE. Validation occurs by comparing the ActualFrame to the header of the CheckFrame. If the headers match, then the payload of ActualFrame is verified for the same pattern Util_FrameSetPayloadData() generates.
Sets all bytes of a frame to 0.

briefdescription.para: Detects the PHY address from MII status register contents.

detaileddescription.para: Looks for a PHY that supports auto-negotiation and 10 Mbps full-duplex and half-duplex. On some older boards PHY address 0 may not respond, but 0 is used as the default when no other address responds.

parameterdescription.para: is a pointer to the Axi Ethernet instance.

simplesect.para: The address of the PHY (defaults to 0 if none is detected).
